financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Registered offering of common stock with accompanying Common Warrants via Maxim Group; net proceeds approx. $3.5M (closing date not stated, 8-K filed 2024-05-13 says proceeds received)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: The Company received gross proceeds from the Offering of approximately $4.0 million, before deducting Placement Agent fees and other estimated offering expenses payable by the Company.

warrants.quote: the Company issued to the Placement Agent, as part of the Placement Agent’s compensation, 188,400 warrants to purchase up to an aggregate of 188,400 shares of Common Stock
